Pid Buffer Pointer to buffer which contains the PID values to configure. Pid Buffer Length Number of PID values in the provided buffer Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Return - E_ OK: Request has been accepted. Specification of LIN Interface AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 92 of 177 Document ID 73 : AUTOSAR_ SWS_ LINInterface - AUTOSAR confidential - Type E_ NOT_ OK: Request has not been accepted, development or production error occurred. Description Sets all assigned PID values. The order is congruent to the LIN frame index. Only applicable for LIN slave nodes. Available via Lin If.h
